documents.text: Museum Tour. Collect guided-tour tickets at the north kiosk. Reference VH-7300.
导览说明。导览票在北侧售票亭领取。
Collect guided-tour tickets at the north kiosk.
red circle
Theatre Entry. The auditorium doors open half an hour before the performance. Reference VH-7301.
剧院说明。演出开始前半小时开放观众厅。
The auditorium doors open half an hour before the performance.
red triangle
Pool Towels. Return used towels to the basket beside the changing rooms. Reference VH-7302.
泳池说明。用过的毛巾放回更衣室旁的篮子。
Return used towels to the basket beside the changing rooms.
red diamond
Campground Quiet. Quiet hours begin at ten in the evening. Reference VH-7303.
营地说明。夜间安静时间从晚上十点开始。
Quiet hours begin at ten in the evening.
red star
Bakery Collection. Collect reserved loaves from the side counter after eight in the morning. Reference VH-7304.
面包说明。预订的面包在早上八点后到侧柜台领取。
Collect reserved loaves from the side counter after eight in the morning.
red cross
Archive Access. Researchers register their visit at the reception terminal. Reference VH-7305.
档案说明。研究人员须在接待处终端登记来访。
Researchers register their visit at the reception terminal.
blue circle
Observatory Weather. Cloudy-night sessions are moved to the indoor planetarium. Reference VH-7306.
天文台说明。多云夜晚的活动改在室内星象馆进行。
Cloudy-night sessions are moved to the indoor planetarium.
blue triangle
Greenhouse Visits. Group visits require advance booking through the garden office. Reference VH-7307.
温室说明。团体参观须提前向园区办公室预约。
Group visits require advance booking through the garden office.
blue diamond
Ferry Boarding. Passengers board the island ferry from pier four. Reference VH-7308.
渡轮说明。前往海岛的乘客从四号码头上船。
Passengers board the island ferry from pier four.
blue star
Boardgame Loans. Borrowed games must include every piece when returned. Reference VH-7309.
桌游说明。归还借用的游戏时必须包含全部配件。
Borrowed games must include every piece when returned.
blue cross
Shelter Orientation. New volunteers attend orientation on Saturday mornings. Reference VH-7310.
收容所说明。新志愿者在周六上午参加入门说明会。
New volunteers attend orientation on Saturday mornings.
green circle
Workshop Equipment. Safety goggles are stored in the cabinet beside the entrance. Reference VH-7311.
工坊说明。护目镜存放在入口旁的柜子中。
Safety goggles are stored in the cabinet beside the entrance.
green triangle
Ceramics Collection. Finished pottery can be collected on the following Tuesday. Reference VH-7312.
陶艺说明。烧制完成的陶器可在下一周二领取。
Finished pottery can be collected on the following Tuesday.
green diamond
Concert Bags. Large bags are checked at the cloakroom before entry. Reference VH-7313.
演唱会说明。大件行李须在入场前寄存在衣帽间。
Large bags are checked at the cloakroom before entry.
green star
Market Lost Property. Lost items are kept at the information booth near the fountain. Reference VH-7314.
集市说明。失物保管在喷泉旁的咨询亭。
Lost items are kept at the information booth near the fountain.
green cross
Photo Club Equipment. Tripods can be borrowed from the equipment desk on club nights. Reference VH-7315.
摄影说明。社团活动当晚可在器材台借用三脚架。
Tripods can be borrowed from the equipment desk on club nights.
yellow circle
Woodland Route. Follow the orange markers to reach the lakeside shelter. Reference VH-7316.
林间步道说明。沿橙色标记行走可抵达湖边休息亭。
Follow the orange markers to reach the lakeside shelter.
yellow triangle
Makerspace Tools. Return hand tools to the numbered slots after each session. Reference VH-7317.
创客空间说明。每次活动后将手工具放回对应编号的槽位。
Return hand tools to the numbered slots after each session.
yellow diamond
Lecture Recordings. Recordings appear in the member portal the next morning. Reference VH-7318.
讲座说明。录播会在次日早上发布到会员门户。
Recordings appear in the member portal the next morning.
yellow star
Sports Lockers. Locker tokens are available from the front desk. Reference VH-7319.
球馆说明。储物柜代币可向前台领取。
Locker tokens are available from the front desk.
yellow cross
Craft Exhibition. Applicants submit three photos of their work with the entry form. Reference VH-7320.
手工展说明。参展申请表须附上三张作品照片。
Applicants submit three photos of their work with the entry form.
black circle
Boathouse Collection. Reserved paddles are collected from the rack beside the office. Reference VH-7321.
船屋说明。预订的船桨在办公室旁的架子上领取。
Reserved paddles are collected from the rack beside the office.
black triangle
Astronomy Club Meetings. The telescope session list is posted on the noticeboard every Monday. Reference VH-7322.
星空社说明。每周一在公告栏张贴望远镜活动安排。
The telescope session list is posted on the noticeboard every Monday.
black diamond
Repair Cafe Intake. Attach a description of the fault before leaving an item at the intake desk. Reference VH-7323.
维修站说明。把物品留在受理台前应附上故障说明。
Attach a description of the fault before leaving an item at the intake desk.
black star
Community Choir Practice. Rehearsals take place in the west hall on Thursday evenings. Reference VH-7324.
合唱团说明。排练在周四晚上于西厅举行。
Rehearsals take place in the west hall on Thursday evenings.
black cross
